Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import gzip, struct, time

def tar_header(name, size, typeflag=b'0'):
    h = bytearray(512)
    def put(off, data, n=None):
        if isinstance(data, str): data=data.encode()
        if n is None: n=len(data)
        h[off:off+min(len(data),n)] = data[:n]
    put(0, name, 100)
    put(100, f'{0o644:07o}\0', 8)
    put(108, f'{0:07o}\0', 8)
    put(116, f'{0:07o}\0', 8)
    put(124, f'{size:011o}\0', 12)
    put(136, f'{int(time.time()):011o}\0', 12)
    h[148:156] = b'        '
    h[156:157] = typeflag
    put(257, b'ustar\0', 6)
    put(263, b'00', 2)
    chksum = sum(h)
    h[148:156] = f'{chksum:06o}\0 '.encode()
    return bytes(h)
size=65536
content=b'A'*size
pad = (512 - (size % 512)) % 512
tar = tar_header('x', size) + content + b'\0'*pad + b'\0'*1024
open('/workspace/poc_gz_tar.bin','wb').write(gzip.compress(tar, compresslevel=9, mtime=0))
print(len(tar), len(gzip.compress(tar, compresslevel=9, mtime=0)))
